variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian of the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith, Mabry the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: This is the Drowned Lantern. I can't promise the beds are dry, stranger.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Out of my forge, stranger! I don't sell blades to BANDITS!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: I hear the wolves are coming right up to the mill now. Time I thought about selling my potions somewhere else.

variants.specifics: Dolgar: Bodric keeps the tavern, Thrum the forge, Ozwick the potion shop.

inn.speaker: Bodric
inn.text: Call yer drink! What'll it be fer you, then?

arms.speaker: Thrum
arms.text: Strangers don't get served in my forge. But for a few coins more, I'll bend the rules for you.

magic.speaker: Ozwick
magic.text: Welcome, Wanderer! I hope you'll bring me a few bat wings from the Deep. I wouldn't mind grinding some into potions myself!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Pellmire: Fennick the innkeeper, Bruda the smith, Yvra the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Fennick
inn.text: Mogrut's Ogres have pulled up the north walkway.

arms.speaker: Bruda
arms.text: It's a bit quiet today, with the frog-jumping fair and all.

magic.speaker: Yvra
magic.text: Sorry, I can't serve you. It would spoil my good name.

variants.specifics: Korlen: Orrin of the Broken Pike inn, Tobb the armourer, Ulda of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Orrin
inn.text: You look like you could use a bath, friend.

arms.speaker: Tobb
arms.text: Pssst! Hey! You there! Want a helmet? Cheapest in Korlen and they're off real Ogre heads!

variants.specifics: Ondel: Fennick of the Rusty Hook inn, Brusk the smith, Moll the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Fennick
inn.text: Sorry friend, you've drunk me dry! There's not a drop of cider left in the house.

arms.speaker: Brusk
arms.text: I hear you came in by the lake road. Brave of you, stranger!

magic.speaker: Moll
magic.text: Wanna buy a potion? They're boiled up from the slimiest weeds at the bottom of Lake Dorrow.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Bolgar the innkeeper, Drogg the smith, Quenby of the Inkwell magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bolgar
inn.text:
A stranger, eh? Most folks here won't trust an outsider, but they've never been past the town gate and I've been clear to the coast! What do they know about anything!? Eh? Heh, heh, heh...

You're always welcome under my roof, friend.

arms.speaker: Drogg
arms.text: Psst! Hey, you! Want a good sword? A shield, perhaps?

variants.specifics: Fort Skarra: Gunnet keeps the inn, Brakka the forge (arms and armour), Yselda the potion and scroll shop.

inn.speaker: Gunnet
inn.text: Welcome! I see my favorite sight -- a traveler with a heavy purse.

magic.speaker: Yselda
magic.text: Mind the ice while you're in Fort Skarra! I keep a whole shelf of potions for broken necks.

variants.specifics: Vurn: Marga at the inn, Torbek the armorer, Zelphine the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Marga
inn.text: Sorry, I only pour for master smiths.

arms.speaker: Torbek
arms.text: Get out, you THIEF! Or I'll fetch the guards!

magic.speaker: Zelphine
magic.text: Adventurers always get a fair price at my shop. What would you like to see?

variants.specifics: Varrow: Dorrit of the Gilded Boar inn, Garrock the smith, Mirabel of Potions Aplenty.

inn.speaker: Dorrit
inn.text: Hello traveler. You know there's not one bed left, what with the north road shut.

arms.speaker: Garrock
arms.text: Better be quick about it the forge is going cold.

magic.speaker: Mirabel
magic.text: Welcome to Potions Aplenty. I believe I still have a couple of spell books in the back.

variants.specifics: Tolm: Bramwick keeps the inn, Kettick the smithy, Zelna the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bramwick
inn.text: A stranger, eh? You'd best turn around and go home. Mark my words, Bolgrum will be stomping through Tolm before long, too! Hard times we're having, isn't it?

arms.speaker: Kettick
arms.text: Ogres trampled the barley. Need a sword?

magic.speaker: Zelna
magic.text: What is it you want, Wanderer? I'm very busy.
